{{Quote|That's not a star cruiser. That's a horse. Horses don't fly.|Cindel Towani|<ref name="CCEA" />}}
'''Horses''' were large, solid-hoofed domesticated mammals with a flowing tail and mane. In some parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], they were used as draft animals, as beasts of burden, or for riding. While "horse" was the vernacular name for the [[Species/Legends|species]] used in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the technical term used by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] was '''equus'''.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Ewok pony.jpg|thumb|right|Ewoks with an Ewok Pony.|250x250px]]
The species ''equus'',<ref name="WoSW" /> commonly referred to as "horse" in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and "pulga" in [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]], was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] type of quadrupedal<ref name="CCEA" /> [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] that lived on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was divided into many breeds of different sizes and morphologies. Large [[Color/Legends|black]] breeds capable of shape-shifting lived on Dathomir,<ref name="WoSW" /> while smaller breeds<ref name="CCEA" /> under one meter at the shoulder<ref name="WoSW" /> called "ponies"&mdash;known as "gaupas" in Ewokese&mdash;dwelled in the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="CCEA" /> The size of an Endorian pony was comparable to that of a young [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[armored rat]].<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> Horses found on [[Tahlboor]] had greenish fur with reddish stripes.<ref name=":2">''[[The Protocol Offensive]]''</ref>

Horses were [[ungulate]]s, using the hooved tip of their toes to move around.<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> Their long, flexible [[Limb/Legends|legs]] allowed them to run really fast, but they were incapable of flying.<ref name="CCEA" /> Their bodies were covered in [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and a mane of even longer, thicker hair grew about their necks and heads. A horse's head featured a long muzzle consisting of the lips and [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. The [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of a horse were on the sides of its skull, and its [[Ear/Legends|ears]] protruded from the top of the head. They came in two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], with the males being called "stallions."<ref name="WoSW" />

Many other species that resembled horses<ref name=":0">{{SWArchive|url=community/askjc/jocasta/askjc20040108.html|text=Ask the Lucasfilm Jedi Council: Does Naboo Have Horses?}}</ref> were often referred to as "[[Equine/Legends|equine]]" or "equinoid," whether related to horses or not. Such beings included the sentient [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> [[Svivreni]],<ref name="g9">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> and [[Thakwaash]].<ref name="UAA" /> Some believed the [[Half-Bothan]]s were temperamental or volatile because of their "equine blood."<ref name="JVS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> [[Bordok/Legends|Bordoks]] were referred either a ponylike or horse-like.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Cracian thumper]]s resembled a mix between a large [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] and a horse.<ref name="Stay on Target sourcebook">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>

==Behavior and intelligence==
Horses could be domesticated so that people could ride them,<ref name="WoSW" /> or to carry and pull loads.<ref name="CCEA" /> For that reason, itinerant portrait photographers were known to bring ponies with them.<ref name="SCT">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref> The taming of a wild horse, however, was reputed to be a difficult and perilous task.<ref name="FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> The ponies raised by the Ewoks were reputed to be swift, brave and tough.<ref name="WoSW" />

==History==
[[File:Pulga.jpg|thumb|A pulga carrying a basket with [[Cindel Towani]] inside.|250x250px]]Ponies were introduced to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by earlier [[Human/Legends|Human]] scouting parties.<ref name=":1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> "Ewok ponies" run wild in the open woodlands and plains of Endor, but were also kept as transport animals by the Ewoks.<ref name="WoSW" /> They mainly used small gaupas to ride, but also used large pulgas for heavier loads.<ref name="CCEA" /> Ponies were not eaten by the [[Condor dragon/Legends|condor dragon]], which found them unpalatable. While larger dragons were known to snatch Ewoks off pony hacks, a mounted Ewok had a better chance of escape, as most would perceive pony and rider as one beast and too heavy to lift.<ref name="WoSW" />
[[File:Protocol_Offensive_Horse.jpg|left|thumb|Equines on [[Tahlboor]]. |250x250px]]
Around [[5 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]]<ref name="Star Wars Omnibus: Droids">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Droids]]''</ref> horses were used on [[Tahlboor]] by the [[Nimondro family]].<ref name=":2" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> when [[Cindel Towani]] was befriended by [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] after her family crashed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], he showed her an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]-made pulga statue, which she identified as a horse, as he misunderstood her request for a star cruiser for a pulga due to sharing the same word. In the quest to rescue the [[Towani family|Towani]] parents, most of the Ewoks involved rode gaupas, while Cindel and Wicket traveled in a children-carrying basket aboard a full-sized pulga.<ref name="CCEA" />

The [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] witches of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] possessed beautiful black horses, which they sometimes rode instead of Dathomiri [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]].<ref name="WoSW" /> Some of the witches, notably [[Charal]], possessed rings of mysterious origin with strange Force "magic" properties that allowed the witches to change the physical shapes of both themselves and their steeds. To lure Cindel into a trap, she changed her own shape into a beautiful lady, and [[Charal's stallion|her horse]] into a white steed.<ref name="BFE" />

The [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] Marauders under King [[Terak]] also used large horses as mounts.<ref name="BFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ewokscrossthehills.jpg|thumb|Horses used by Ewoks in ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''.|250x250px]]
Real horses were used during the production of ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'' and ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''.<ref name="CCEA" /><ref name="BFE" />

Horses were mentioned by [[Cliegg Lars]] in the German dub of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

A [[2004]] discussion on the [[StarWars.com]]'s "Ask the Lucasfilm Jedi Council" feauture indicated that the horse-like statues seen in the ending of {{Film|I}} were revealed to be statues of [[Guarlara/Legends|guarlaras]]. It further commented that other horse-like species included were [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Bordok/Legends|bordoks]] and gaupas.<ref name=":0" /> The latter statement would indicate that gaupas and horses are not the same species, but ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' states that wild ponies were introduced by [[Human/Legends|humans]] on Endor.<ref name=":1" />

In the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|The Clone Wars]]'' the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]]-sound was a mixture of a horse and a shrieking parrot.<ref name="Back from the Drawing Board">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
